selection: PersonaPlex is the strongest directly relevant starting point among the inspected released voice-persona models. Moshi has the clearest official fine-tuning path. This is a task-specific selection, not a claim of universal benchmark leadership. MiniCPM-o 4.5 is also a serious current full-duplex alternative.
size_definition: Parameter counts below are Hugging Face safetensors metadata, not rounded marketing names. Download bytes do not equal runtime or training memory. External codec is listed separately where present.

models.name: PersonaPlex-7B-v1
models.fit: Released role and voice conditioning; character fine-tuning still requires audio data and an adapted training implementation. Prompt control alone is not Jun trained into weights.

models.name: Moshiko
models.fit: Official LoRA recipe and MLX inference implementation; strong engineering baseline for character-in-weights speech experiments.

models.name: MiniCPM-o 4.5
models.fit: Qwen3-8B-based multimodal alternative; training support via LLaMA-Factory/SWIFT must be checked specifically for duplex speech, not assumed from generic fine-tuning support. Reported memory exceeds the local machine.

benchmarks.caveat: Author-reported benchmark latencies, not measured here or promised on this Mac.

benchmarks.benchmark: Released-checkpoint dialog naturalness MOS, same study/annotator pool
benchmarks.caveat: Do not compare these scores directly to the paper's separate Table 1 annotator study.
Experimental PersonaPlex configuration, not automatically the downloadable checkpoint; model versions and evaluator are those of the paper.

rejected_shortcut.finding: The reported 773M total-parameter Qwen/Mimi experiment produced coherent text but persistently garbled audio and remained unfinished. It does not establish a ready small duplex model suitable for this deliverable.

local_limitation: The available M2 has 8 GB unified memory and no CUDA. The local Qwen character LoRA is a text checkpoint, not native speech. A validated speech checkpoint and measured overlap/interruption behavior remain required for the speech milestone.
